verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for a phone service that stores call history, voicemail and transcripts, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions retention periods, deleting voicemails or call records, or account data deletion. The only nearby evidence is app and dashboard management of calls and voicemail, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
